name: Chief's Da Tiki Bar
notes: Photo 1 is a legible food menu headed 'JJ's Island Grindz' (a sushi vendor's menu, filed under this restaurant's Google Maps Menu photos) and is the source of all dishes below. Photos 2 and 3 are a happy-hour chalkboard and a full spirits/wine/beer list — both drink-only, skipped per rules. Sashimi/Nigiri items with two prices (sashimi cut vs. nigiri cut) are recorded with both prices in the description rather than a single price field. Add-on modifiers (add masago, add avocado, spicy +$1, add chicken/beef/shrimp kelaguen) were omitted.
